lines: Well done my friend, you passed every given test successfully
And the Ultimate campaign is now over.
However, don't believe that your adventure ends here !
You can still download new maps or play other campaigns.
You can also try to beat your time and take
The first place on the leaderboards !
Don't forget to visit the blog to get latest news :
http://stillalivejs.t4ils.com/
See you another time !
Thank you for playing Still Alive
I hope you had as fun playing the game as I had making it
Game created by t4ils
Gfx by ZeBlackos (thanks !!!)
Original idea from Valve Software
Thanks my life partner who let me create my game during
these past 2 months where I spent most of my time
on the computer (sorry about that !)
Big thanks to Braynor and LordYu for their thorough beta
test during all the development phase.
Thanks to EvilTroopa and dev-fr.org for their support
While making the game and for testing the game.
Thanks to Trackmania and StillAliveDS forum members
For testing the game in its almost complete version.
